Based on its experience, TSA estimates that 100 applicants per year will be required to fill out the MHC form, which takes approximately 1 hour to complete. Applicants can be any member of the public, therefore TSA uses the Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) all occupations (00-0000) mean wage rate of $32.66 per hour.  TSA then applies a load factor of 1.4582 to account for non-compensation costs of employment, such as health and retirement benefits. The travel time burden is recognized for applicants only, as incumbents’ travel time is considered to be within the scope of their duties as TSA employees. provenance.original: To estimate how many new Cybersecurity Coordinators and alternate coordinators will need to be appointed each year, TSA first estimates the number of existing coordinators and alternates. TSA uses the Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) turnover rates to estimate that approximately 4 percent of the current population of Cybersecurity Coordinators and alternate Cybersecurity Coordinators will separate from their positions and require replacement each year. Applying this percentage to the population of covered Owner/Operators results in 117 new Cybersecurity Coordinators per year for freight rail operators (898 Owner/Operators × 13%), 63 for passenger rail (484 Owner/Operators × 13%), and 19 for OTRB (144 Owner/Operators × 13%).
